title: Successive visited-position sets
statement: For a multi-tape Turing machine $M$, initial state $q$, input word $V$, time $t\in\mathbb N$, and work tape $i$, the set of head positions visited from time $0$ through time $t+1$ is the set of positions visited from time $0$ through time $t$, with the head position at time $t$ added.
hypotheses_covered: time t is a natural number
